# Incident write-up: financial-summary metrics disagree with source data at the margins

## Issue details

Several of the read-only routines that roll raw bank-feed, credit-bureau, and
accounting exports up into the structured metric blocks on the underwriting
surface are emitting figures that do not match their inputs - but only for a
narrow class of records. Every reproduction gathered so far sits on a margin of
some kind: a quantity landing exactly on a documented cut-off instead of
comfortably past it; a report handed over at the smallest column or period count
the format permits; a collection holding an even pair, so the count itself is
what decides the answer; and a field carrying one of the
reserved "nothing here" placeholder codes that is being echoed back as if it
were a genuine amount. Hand the same routines data sitting well inside the usual
ranges and the numbers come out right, which is why nothing stood out in review.

## Expected outcome

Each metric should agree with what the source record plainly says at these
margins. A value resting on a threshold is handled the way the documented rule
for that threshold states. The smallest well-formed report still yields its
per-period figures. A two-element collection is measured from its actual
contents rather than dismissed as too small. A
reserved placeholder code is discarded, never read as data. Everywhere away from
the margins the output must not move at all.

## Affected areas

The fault is contained in the deterministic, side-effect-free summarization
layer: plain arithmetic, comparisons, and roll-ups over already-parsed bank,
credit, and accounting structures. No database, network, or model component is
in the loop. Each wrong figure traces to how one boundary - or one reserved
value - is treated inside that computation, so the corrections are small and
local.

## Testing notes

The existing automated checks all pass today and must still pass afterward; they
only ever drive mid-range inputs, so they are silent about the margins described
above. Judge the fix on whether the summaries come out correct on the
exact-threshold, minimum-size, single/pair, and placeholder-code cases. Do not
touch anything under the project's `tests` tree.

Reproduce and confirm with:

    cd /app/loangen-agent && python -m pytest tests -v

# Codebase Map: /app/loangen-agent — Deterministic Financial Summarization Layer

## 1. Directory Structure (relevant portions)

```
/app/loangen-agent/
├── agent/
│   ├── analytics/                      # <== CORE deterministic summarization layer
│   │   ├── models/                     # Pydantic schemas for metric blocks
│   │   │   ├── plaid.py                #   AccountSummary, MonthlyCashFlow, CashFlowMetrics, RiskFlags, PlaidAnalyticsResult
│   │   │   ├── credit_bureau.py        #   CreditAnalyticsResult, TradelineAnalysis, CreditSummaryMetrics, ...
│   │   │   └── quickbooks.py           #   QBAnalyticsResult, IncomeStatement, BalanceSheetData, AgingData, ...
│   │   ├── services/                   # The roll-up/compute routines (see section 2)
│   │   ├── router.py                   # HTTP endpoints exposing analytics
│   │   └── seed.py
│   ├── tools/                          # Agent-facing service wrappers + qualification math
│   ├── services/cre_qualification/     # Deterministic CRE metric resolution/scoring over parsed doc facts
│   ├── documents/
│   │   ├── report/                     # Deterministic per-document metric-card/report builders
│   │   ├── deal_summary/               # Portfolio/deal roll-ups (merger.py, portfolio.py)
│   │   └── credit_pdf/                 # Credit PDF parse -> MISMO (feeds credit analytics)
│   ├── plaid/                          # Plaid integration; report_service.py builds bank report views
│   ├── array/                          # Array.com credit bureau integration; narrative/PDF from analytics
│   ├── integrations/quickbooks/        # QBO API client/webhooks (raw report ingestion)
│   ├── pipeline.py                     # Chat pipeline; injects checklist JSON blocks into LLM context
│   └── ...
├── tests/                              # 33 pytest files (flat)
├── docs/BANK_ANALYTICS_CHECKLIST.md    # Field definitions & formulas for bank checklist v1
└── training/, deploy/, docker/
```

## 2. Summarization / Metric Computation Files

### Core layer: `agent/analytics/services/`

**`plaid_analytics.py` (860 lines) — bank-feed roll-ups**
- `_parse_month` (L52), `_compute_volatility` (L56): YYYY-MM keying; stdev/mean coefficient-of-variation %.
- `compute_plaid_analytics` (L65): main entry — validates raw Plaid `/transactions/get` JSON, then pure arithmetic: account balance/utilization roll-ups, monthly inflow/outflow aggregation, expense/income category breakdowns, income-source frequency classification, RiskFlags (gambling txns, loan payments, fees, declining 3-month balance trend L262-266, >75% credit utilization), and a 0-100 additive cash-flow score with tier bands (L281-328).
- `_enumerate_months_inclusive` (L356), `_fixed_vs_discretionary_expense` (L373).
- `build_bank_analytics_checklist_v1` (L385): chat-oriented checklist block from `PlaidAnalyticsResult.model_dump()` — total credit limit, near-limit counts, missing-month detection, totals/largest flows, cash-flow pattern classification (comparison thresholds L432-445), income/expense concentration percentages, `_risk_band` (L462).
- `fetch_latest_bank_checklist_json_for_user` (L603); `PlaidAnalyticsService` (L618) — `get_analytics` (L656) orchestrates mock vs. live+normalized data, `_build_raw_json_from_normalized` (L754), `_item_to_raw`/`_account_to_raw`/`_transaction_to_raw` (L795/816/834).

**`credit_bureau_analytics.py` (776 lines) — credit-bureau (Array.com MISMO 2.4) roll-ups**
- Helpers: `_safe_int` (L79), `_safe_float` (L92) — handle bureau sentinel values (-3/-4/-5/"N/A"); `_get_summary_value` (L104).
- `_classify_risk_tier` (L111): score → tier band. `_analyze_factor` (L124), `_analyze_inquiry` (L138), `_filter_inquiries_last_2_years` (L151).
- `_count_raw_inquiries` (L174), `_count_raw_payment_patterns` (L185), `_needs_detail_refresh` (L217).
- `_analyze_tradeline` (L247): per-liability normalization (late 30/60/90 counts, utilization, open/collection/chargeoff flags).
- `_extract_summary_metrics` (L306): maps CREDIT_SUMMARY attribute IDs (AP001, AT02S, PT016, ...) into `CreditSummaryMetrics`.
- `compute_credit_analytics` (L337): main entry — score/factors/tradeline summary counts/inquiries/risk tier → `CreditAnalyticsResult`.
- `build_credit_analytics_checklist_v1` (L417): compact chat checklist — top-3 factors, open-tradeline monthly-payment sum, severe-delinquency and delinquent-open counts (comparisons L437-450), summary metrics block.
- `fetch_latest_raw_credit_json_for_user` (L488), `fetch_latest_credit_analysis_json_for_user` (L513); `CreditBureauAnalyticsService` (L549) with `_get_previous_score` (L561, score-delta) and `get_analytics` (L625).

**`quickbooks_analytics.py` (641 lines) — accounting-export roll-ups**
- QB JSON navigation: `_safe_float` (L41), `_get_coldata_values` (L50), `_find_section` (L54), `_find_summary_value` (L66), `_extract_monthly_from_summary` (L78), `_extract_data_rows` (L88), `_row_to_line_item` (L95).
- Report parsers over already-fetched JSON: `parse_profit_and_loss` (L119), `parse_balance_sheet` (L170, with nested finders L174/L187 — computes current ratio, D/E), `parse_cash_flow` (L258), `parse_aging` (L300, AR/AP buckets), `parse_company_info` (L354).
- `_compute_seasonality` (L395): peak/trough 3-month averages, ratio, risk band.
- `compute_qb_analytics` (L436): main entry — YoY revenue growth (L462-464), monthly burn rate (L468), runway = cash/burn (L471), DSCR = (net income + depreciation + interest) / (debt repayment + interest) (L473-483) → `QBAnalyticsResult` with revenue/COGS/GP/margins/ratios.
- `QuickBooksAnalyticsService` (L518), `get_analytics` (L556).

**Orchestration/persistence (compute + store on ingest):**
- `bank_plaid_analytics_service.py`: `BankPlaidAnalyticsService.compute_and_store` (L22) — runs compute_plaid_analytics + checklist, persists to Mongo.
- `credit_report_analytics_service.py`: `CreditReportAnalyticsService.compute_and_store` (L24) — same for credit.
- `credit_cache_service.py`: Redis caching of `CreditAnalyticsResult` — `get_analytics_cached` (L66), `invalidate_analytics_cache` (L98), `_is_stale_cached_shape` (L45).

### Secondary deterministic layers

**`agent/tools/qualification_engine.py`** — plain-arithmetic qualification:
- `_safe_num` (L16), `compute_dscr` (L26), `QualificationEngine.qualify` (L46, threshold comparisons vs. lender criteria), `match_lenders` (L162), `detect_savings_opportunities` (L252). Static lender criteria table L300+.

**`agent/tools/{plaid_bank,credit_bureau,quickbooks}.py`** — service wrappers returning pre-computed/mock structured summaries (ratios pre-computed here, per docstrings; LLM never sees raw data): `PlaidBankService` (plaid_bank.py L205: `get_bank_data`/`get_cash_flow_score`/`get_monthly_trend`), `CreditBureauService` (credit_bureau.py L214: `get_reports`/`get_fico_score`), `QuickBooksService` (quickbooks.py L216: `get_company`/`get_financials`/`get_readiness_score`).

**`agent/services/cre_qualification/`** — deterministic metric resolution over parsed document facts:
- `facts.py`: ~40 resolver functions — e.g. `resolve_liquid_assets` (L62), `resolve_net_worth` (L109), `compute_noi` (L194), `resolve_t12_noi` (L198), `compute_debt_capacity` (L375), `merge_facts_from_sources` (L397).
- `scoring.py`: `clamp` (L10), `score_higher_better`/`score_lower_better` (L20/30), `weighted_score` (L36), `coverage_pct` (L51), `normalize_dscr_for_pd`/`normalize_ltv_for_pd` (L59/65), `logistic_pd` (L77).
- `cross_checks.py`: `_compare` (L24), `run_all_cross_checks` (L54) — cross-document consistency comparisons.

**`agent/documents/report/builders.py`** — deterministic metric-card/report blocks per document type: `build_report_from_facts` (L23) dispatching to `_build_tax_report` (L90), `_build_pfs_report` (L137), `_build_t12_report` (L386), etc.; helpers `_pfs_line_items` (L531), `_chart_from_*` (L586-603).

**`agent/documents/deal_summary/portfolio.py`** — `merge_portfolio_property` (L36), `_recompute_pl_portfolio` (L118): portfolio P&L roll-ups.

**`agent/plaid/report_service.py`** — bank-report view assembly: `build_bank_report_view` (L26), `build_bank_report_view_from_preview_payload` (L118).

**Consumer:** `agent/pipeline.py` (L351-560) pulls persisted `credit_analytics_checklist_v1` / `bank_analytics_checklist_v1` blocks (falling back to live compute) and injects them into chat context.

## 3. Tests

All tests live flat in `/app/loangen-agent/tests/` (33 files). Coverage relevant to the summarization layer:

- `tests/test_credit_pdf_upload.py` — the only direct test of the analytics compute layer: `test_end_to_end_mismo_and_analytics` (L157) runs `compute_credit_analytics` (imported L9) on a parsed Xactus tri-merge PDF; also covers report-source detection, tradeline/inquiry/summary-metric parsing, validation.
- `tests/test_credit_pdf_pipeline.py` — credit PDF parse/normalize/reconcile pipeline feeding credit analytics.
- `tests/test_cre_qualification.py` — `run_qualification_engine`, `run_all_cross_checks`, `weighted_score`, recommendation resolution.
- `tests/test_bridge_broadway_qualification.py`, `tests/test_oak_hill_qualification.py` — scenario-based engine runs incl. fact resolvers (`resolve_liquid_assets`, `resolve_construction_budget`).
- `tests/test_qualification_recommendation.py`, `tests/test_lender_product_match.py`, `tests/test_required_docs.py` — recommendation, lender matching, required-doc gating.
- `tests/test_document_report.py` — `build_report_from_facts` deterministic report builders, report support/availability.
- `tests/test_cre_field_extraction.py`, `test_bridge_broadway_extraction.py`, `test_oak_hill_extraction.py` — upstream fact extraction feeding the resolvers.

**Gap worth noting:** there are no dedicated tests for `plaid_analytics.py` (`compute_plaid_analytics`, `build_bank_analytics_checklist_v1`) or `quickbooks_analytics.py` (`compute_qb_analytics` and its report parsers) — grep of `tests/` shows only `test_credit_pdf_upload.py` importing from `agent.analytics`. The bank checklist formulas are instead documented in `docs/BANK_ANALYTICS_CHECKLIST.md`.

261:     # --- Risk flags ---

276:         high_fee_count=risk_fees,
277:         declining_balance_trend=declining,
278:         high_utilization_credit=high_util,
279:     )

281:     # --- Cash flow score (0-100) ---
282:     score = 50
283:     if avg_net > 0:
284:         score += min(20, int(avg_net / 500))
285:     else:
286:         score -= min(20, int(abs(avg_net) / 500))

288:     if runway > 6:
289:         score += 15

292:     elif runway > 1:

356: def _enumerate_months_inclusive(start_ym: str, end_ym: str) -> list[str]:
357:     """Return YYYY-MM strings from start through end inclusive."""
358:     if not start_ym or not end_ym or len(start_ym) < 7 or len(end_ym) < 7:
359:         return []
360:     y1, m1 = int(start_ym[:4]), int(start_ym[5:7])
361:     y2, m2 = int(end_ym[:4]), int(end_ym[5:7])
362:     out: list[str] = []
363:     y, m = y1, m1
364:     while (y, m) <= (y2, m2):
365:         out.append(f"{y:04d}-{m:02d}")
366:         m += 1
367:         if m > 12:
368:             m = 1
369:             y += 1
370:     return out

1: # Bank analytics checklist (`bank_analytics_checklist_v1`)
2: 
3: Structured JSON for **bank / cash-flow** answers in chat. It is built by `build_bank_analytics_checklist_v1()` in `agent/analytics/services/plaid_analytics.py` from a `PlaidAnalyticsResult` (see `compute_plaid_analytics()` in the same module).
4: 
5: ## Storage (MongoDB)
6: 
7: | Item | Value |
8: |------|--------|
9: | Beanie model | `PlaidBankAnalysis` (`agent/analytics/models/plaid.py`) |
10: | Collection | `plaid_bank_analysis` |
11: | Key | `userId` (unique, one document per user) |
12: | Document field | `analysis` |
13: 
14: `analysis` shape:
15: 
16: ```json
17: {
18:   "bank_analytics_checklist_v1": { /* ... */ },
19:   "plaid_analytics_snapshot": { /* full PlaidAnalyticsResult.model_dump() */ }
20: }
21: ```
22: 
23: **Population:** `BankPlaidAnalyticsService.compute_and_store()` after a successful Plaid sync, or `POST /api/v1/internal/plaid/analytics/rebuild` (authenticated user).
24: 
25: **Chat:** For `bank_cashflow` intent, `agent/pipeline.py` loads `bank_analytics_checklist_v1` via `fetch_latest_bank_checklist_json_for_user(user_id)`. If missing and `DATA_MODE=live`, it computes live `PlaidAnalyticsService.get_analytics()` and builds the checklist without persisting. Injected between `=== BANK_ANALYTICS_JSON_START ===` / `=== BANK_ANALYTICS_JSON_END ===`.
26: 
27: **Env:** `CHAT_ENRICHMENT_BANK_CHECKLIST_FROM_DB` (default `true`), `CHAT_BANK_ANALYTICS_JSON_MAX_CHARS` (`0` = no truncation).
28: 
29: ---
30: 
31: ## Plaid amount convention (upstream)
32: 
33: In `compute_plaid_analytics()`:
34: 
35: - **Positive `amount`** → treated as **outflow** (spending).
36: - **Negative `amount`** → treated as **inflow** (income).
37: 
38: Monthly buckets:
39: 
40: - `total_inflows[month]` += `abs(amount)` for negative amounts.
41: - `total_outflows[month]` += `amount` for positive amounts.
42: 
43: ---
44: 
45: ## Root fields of `bank_analytics_checklist_v1`
46: 
47: | Field | Meaning |
48: |-------|---------|
49: | `version` | Always `"bank_analytics_checklist_v1"`. |
50: | `smb_id` | SMB / user id from analytics. |
51: | `institution_name` | Plaid item institution name. |
52: | `data_date` | UTC date string when analytics were computed. |
53: | `date_range` | `{ "start", "end" }` from min/max transaction dates in the raw pull. |
54: 
55: ---
56: 
57: ## `account_structure`
58: 
59: | Field | Derivation |
60: |-------|------------|
61: | `account_count` | `len(accounts)` from Plaid. |
62: | `account_types` | Count of accounts by `type` (e.g. depository, credit). |
63: | `total_balance` | Sum of `current_balance` across accounts. |
64: | `total_available` | Sum of `available_balance` across accounts. |
65: | `credit_exposure.total_credit_limit` | Sum of `credit_limit` for accounts with `type == "credit"`. |
66: | `credit_exposure.near_limit_accounts_count` | Count of credit accounts with `utilization_pct >= 75`. |
67: | `credit_exposure.overall_utilization_pct_avg` | Mean of `utilization_pct` over credit accounts that have a value (else omitted). |
68: | `credit_exposure.high_utilization_flag` | `risk_flags.high_utilization_credit` from analytics. |
69: | `accounts_sample` | First 30 `AccountSummary` rows (full list in snapshot). |
70: 
71: ---
72: 
73: ## `monthly_flow`
74: 
75: ### Month list and gaps
76: 
77: | Field | Formula |
78: |-------|---------|
79: | `months_covered` | Sorted unique `month` values from `monthly_cash_flows` (`YYYY-MM`). |
80: | `months_count` | `len(months_covered)`. |
81: | `expected_months_in_range` | If `months_count >= 2`, every calendar month from first to last inclusive (`_enumerate_months_inclusive`); else `[]`. |
82: | `missing_months_in_range` | `expected_months_in_range` minus months that appear in `months_covered` (no transactions in that month). |
83: 
84: ### Series and totals
85: 
86: | Field | Formula |
87: |-------|---------|
88: | `series` | Full `monthly_cash_flows` array (each month: `total_inflows`, `total_outflows`, `net_cash_flow`, counts, `largest_inflow` / `largest_outflow`, `ending_balance_estimate`). |
89: | `totals.total_inflows` | Sum of `total_inflows` across all months in `series`. |
90: | `totals.total_outflows` | Sum of `total_outflows` across all months. |
91: | `totals.net_cash_flow` | `total_inflows - total_outflows`. |
92: 
93: ### Averages (`averages` from `cash_flow_metrics`)
94: 
95: | Metric | Formula |
96: |--------|---------|
97: | `avg_monthly_inflow` | Arithmetic mean of `monthly_inflows[m]` for each month `m` in the analysis window. |
98: | `avg_monthly_outflow` | Mean of `monthly_outflows[m]`. |
99: | `avg_monthly_net` | Mean of `(inflow - outflow)` per month. |
100: 
101: ### Volatility (`stability`)
102: 
103: | Metric | Formula |
104: |--------|---------|
105: | `inflow_volatility_pct` | Coefficient of variation of monthly inflows: \(\text{round}\left(\frac{\text{stdev}(\text{inflow values})}{\text{mean}(\text{inflow values})} \times 100,\, 1\right)\). If fewer than 2 months or mean = 0 → `0`. |
106: | `outflow_volatility_pct` | Same formula on monthly outflow values. |
107: | `months_with_negative_flow` | Count of months where `net_cash_flow < 0`. |
108: | `runway_months` | `total_balance / avg_monthly_outflow` if `avg_monthly_outflow > 0`, else `99.0` (placeholder “long runway” when no spend). |
109: 
110: ### Extremes
111: 
112: | Field | Formula |
113: |-------|---------|
114: | `largest_inflow` | Max of `largest_inflow` across months. |
115: | `largest_outflow` | Max of `largest_outflow` across months. |
116: 
117: ### `interpretation` (pattern label)
118: 
119: | `pattern` | Rule (in order) |
120: |-----------|-----------------|
121: | `negative_months_stress` | `months_with_negative_flow >= 3`. |
122: | `strong_affordability` | `avg_monthly_net > 0` and `inflow_volatility_pct < 20` and `outflow_volatility_pct < 20`. |
123: | `medium_risk_volatility` | `avg_monthly_net > 0` and (`inflow_volatility_pct > 35` or `outflow_volatility_pct > 35`). |
124: | `mixed` | Otherwise. |
125: 
126: ---
127: 
128: ## `categories_and_sources`
129: 
130: ### `income_sources`
131: 
132: Up to 40 rows from `PlaidAnalyticsResult.income_sources`, sorted by `total_amount` descending. Each row is built from grouped negative-amount transactions (see `IncomeSource` model): `description`, `category`, `total_amount`, `avg_amount`, `transaction_count`, `frequency` (`monthly` / `recurring` / `occasional` based on count vs month span).
133: 
134: ### `expense_categories`
135: 
136: Top 25 expense categories by `total_amount`, each from `CategoryBreakdown` plus:
137: 
138: | Field | Formula |
139: |-------|---------|
140: | `fixed_vs_discretionary` | `_fixed_vs_discretionary_expense(primary_category)`: `RENT_AND_UTILITIES` and `LOAN_PAYMENTS` → `fixed`; `BANK_FEES`, `GOVERNMENT_AND_NON_PROFIT` → `fixed` among other expense primaries; other `EXPENSE_PRIMARIES` → `discretionary`; else `mixed`. |
141: 
142: ### `concentration_risk`
143: 
144: | Field | Formula |
145: |-------|---------|
146: | `top_income_source_pct` | `100 * income_sources[0].total_amount / sum(all total_amount)` (or `0` if no sources). |
147: | `top_3_income_sources_pct` | Same for top 3 sources. |
148: | `top_expense_category_pct` | `pct_of_total` of the largest expense category. |
149: | `top_3_expense_categories_pct` | Sum of `pct_of_total` for top 3 expense categories. |
150: | `income_concentration_risk` | `_risk_band(top1_pct)`: `high` if ≥ 60%, `medium` if ≥ 35%, else `low`. |
151: | `expense_concentration_risk` | `_risk_band(top_expense_category_pct)` on the top expense share. |
152: 
153: ---
154: 
155: ## `risk_flags` (from `RiskFlags`)
156: 
157: | Field | Source |
158: |-------|--------|
159: | `nsf_overdraft_indicators` | Model default `0` unless extended elsewhere (not currently incremented in `compute_plaid_analytics`). |
160: | `high_fee_count` | Count of transactions with `primary == "BANK_FEES"`. |
161: | `loan_payment_count` / `loan_payment_total` | Transactions with `primary == "LOAN_PAYMENTS"` (total uses absolute flow). |
162: | `declining_balance_trend` | True if last 3 `ending_balance_estimate` values are strictly decreasing (requires ≥ 3 months). |
163: | `gambling_transactions` | Count where `detailed == "ENTERTAINMENT_CASINOS_AND_GAMBLING"` (see `RISK_CATEGORIES`). |
164: 
165: ---
166: 
167: ## `scores`
168: 
169: | Field | Derivation |
170: |-------|------------|
171: | `cash_flow_score` | Heuristic 0–100: starts at 50; adjusts for avg net, runway, negative months, inflow volatility, gambling, fees, declining balance, high utilization (see `compute_plaid_analytics`). |
172: | `cash_flow_tier` | `excellent` / `good` / `fair` / `poor` / `very_poor` from score bands. |
173: 
174: ---

176: ## `reconciliation`
177: 
178: Placeholder for future credit-bureau + accounting joins. `status` is always `"not_available"` in v1; `credit_bureau_monthly_payment_total` and `accounting_debt_payment_total` are `null`.
179: 
180: ---
181: 
182: ## `checklist` (underwriting-style gates)
183: 
184: | Key | Meaning |
185: |-----|---------|
186: | `no_unexplained_data_gaps_in_monthly_series` | `status`: no missing months inside the span; lists `missing_months`. |
187: | `net_cash_trend_reviewed_for_window` | `status`: at least 2 months observed. |
188: | `volatility_measured_and_interpreted` | Always `status: true`; echoes volatility percentages. |
189: | `negative_month_count_documented` | Always `true`; echoes `months_with_negative_flow`. |
190: | `concentration_risks_noted` | Always `true`; echoes top income/expense percentages. |
191: | `bounce_dishonor_nsf_signals_reviewed` | Always `true`; echoes `high_fee_count` and `nsf_overdraft_indicators`. |
192: | `bank_observed_debt_payments_reconciled_with_bureau_accounting` | Always `status: false`, `reason: reconciliation_not_available`. |

steps.message:
Fixed. Four one-line boundary corrections in the deterministic summarization layer, one per reproduction class in the incident:

**1. Exact-threshold cut-off** — `agent/analytics/services/plaid_analytics.py:406`
`near_limit_accounts_count` used `utilization_pct > 75.0`, but the documented rule (`docs/BANK_ANALYTICS_CHECKLIST.md` L66) is `>= 75`. An account sitting exactly at 75.0% was excluded from the near-limit count. Changed `>` to `>=`.

**2. Even-pair collection** — `agent/analytics/services/plaid_analytics.py:57`
`_compute_volatility` returned `0.0` when `len(values) <= 2`, dismissing a two-month series even though stdev is defined for n=2 (docs L105: "If fewer than 2 months or mean = 0 → 0"). Changed to `< 2`; a pair like `[1000, 2000]` now yields its true 47.1% coefficient of variation instead of 0.

**3. Reserved placeholder code** — `agent/analytics/services/credit_bureau_analytics.py:97`
`_safe_float` filtered bureau sentinels `-3.0`/`-4.0` but not `-5.0` ("Not applicable for this bureau", per the module's own header comment), so `-5` was echoed back as a genuine balance/limit/payment amount — poisoning tradeline utilization and summary metrics. Added `-5.0` to match `_safe_int` (line 85). Real negative amounts (e.g. `-2.5`) are unaffected.

**4. Minimum-size report** — `agent/analytics/services/quickbooks_analytics.py:83`
`_extract_monthly_from_summary` bailed when `len(col_data) <= num_months + 2`, but a well-formed QB summary row is exactly `[label, month1..monthN, total]` = N+2 columns, so per-period figures (monthly income → seasonality) were dropped, including the smallest 1-period report. Changed to `<`, mirroring the correct `>= num_months + 2` guard already used in `_row_to_line_item` (line 103). Truly short/malformed rows still return `[]`.

Verification:
- All 14 margin/mid-range repro checks pass (exact-75, pair, 1-period and 12-period summaries, all sentinel codes, plus off-margin controls confirming unchanged behavior).
- `python -m pytest tests -v`: 166 passed / 24 skipped, with a failure set byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (7 pre-existing failures in `test_inbound_calls`, `test_ingestion_stale_recovery`, `test_document_ingestion_readiness`, `test_document_report` — unrelated Twilio/ingestion areas, confirmed via `git stash` diff of failure lists).
- Nothing under `tests/` was touched.
